No high or medium finding failed outright; the sub-claims that failed are named in their notes. Of the seven highs (five distinct), two truly mislead a reader: the missing authorship and the card times. Numbering, ONE-PAGE.zh and TESTS.zh are real and medium by AGENTS' order.

One constraint on every first-screen fix: READING-BUDGETS row 27 has the screen at 553 words, 403 over the 150 target. Reviewers' additions total well over 100 words, so they need paired cuts. Hedges in the lead cannot be the cuts.

Q1 (6, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, zh 6): fair at about 7, zh 6. The stated blockers are the true ones: authorship, the knotted lead, no purpose, nothing on what survives. All are in reach, every sentence having a home. Unusable as written: site's 'with AI' (fails the test), growth's 'unqualified' lead.

Q2 (7.5, 7, 7.5, 8, 8, 7, zh 6): fair at 7 to 7.5 as built. The two 8s did not examine the card times or chapter pages. Unification's 'the switch alone reaches 8' does not hold: the switch adds only a public URL, the map without a clone, and links that resolve. Blockers are builder work: card times, marks in tables, chapter contents, doubled nav, wide tables, search. In reach.

Q3 (7, 7, 6.5, 8, 8, 8, zh 6): fair at 7. True blockers: shape against measure, shared laws unseen, loom's first view. In reach, except per-chapter standings, which first need declarations placed in chapters (rw-spine/README.md). No claim changes.

Q4 (8, 8, 8, 7, 8, 8, zh 7): fair at 7.5. Growth's 7 read the most and found what the 8s missed. Fixing numbering, adding a sourced arc, a second thread and a coverage paragraph reach 8; all in lineage.json and lineage.py. Zh also needs evidence links.

Q5 (6, 7, 7.5, 7, 6, 7, 7): fair at 6.5 to 7. True blocker: no statement of what survives, and the case undersold. In reach, with a ceiling: no deployed test exists and new runs are held, so the value can be said more plainly, not made larger. Keep 'none of them a discovery'.

Q6 (8, 8, 8, 8, 7, 8, 8): fair at 7.5 to 8. Uses read the most; its 7 rests on findings that mostly hold. Reaching a firm 8 needs plainer cells, exits and design laws named at standing, and development and wisdom additions. No claim changes.

Q7 (7, 7, 7.5, 7, 7, 7, zh 6): fair at 7, zh 6. True blockers: nav absent on hand-written fronts, no 'worth seeing first' selection, RESULTS and OPEN-QUESTIONS heads, no search. In reach.
